test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes the** resilient and hopeful spirit attributed to Queen Gulnaar.**
 
• **"Undaunted"** means not intimidated or discouraged by difficulty, danger, or disappointment, which fits well with the description of the human spirit in the context.
 
• Other options like **"unbelievable", "ungrateful", and "unsafe**" do not appropriately describe the hopeful and resilient nature of the spirit being talked about.
 
• Tthe correct word for fill in the blanks no. 4 is '**Undaunted.'**

Therefore, the correct statement of the given passage is **"She speaks of the undaunted, ever hopeful human spirit........."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Unbelievable"** means something that is difficult to believe, which does not fit the context here.
 
• **"Ungrateful" **means not feeling or showing gratitude, which does not align with the context.
 
• **"Unsafe"** means not safe, which does not describe the resilient and hopeful spirit mentioned in the passage.
